verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Supabase branching creates preview environments from production (supabase-docs-26, supabase-docs-36), but nothing in the pack describes resetting a branch to its parent's state or restoring a branch to an earlier point without rebuilding from a dump. Missing for 10: any documentation of a branch-reset/restore command or workflow, evidence of point-in-time restore applied to branches, or community confirmation this works as described.
